# atproto_tangled_profile (Resource)

Manages the account's Tangled profile. There is one profile per account, so creating this resource adopts an existing profile. The avatar is left as it is.

Manages a `sh.tangled.actor.profile` record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atproto_tangled_profile" "me" {
  bluesky     = true
  description = "Mostly Go and Nix."
  links       = ["https://example.com"]
  stats       = ["repository-count", "star-count"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bluesky` (Boolean) Link to this account on Bluesky.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form profile description.
- `links` (List of String) Up to 5 URIs, such as social profiles or websites.
- `location` (String) Free-form location.
- `pinned_repositories` (List of String) Up to 6 pinned repositories, as repo DIDs or AT URIs.
- `preferred_handle` (String) Handle to display the account as.
- `pronouns` (String) Preferred pronouns.
- `stats` (List of String) Up to 2 vanity stats to show. One of `merged-pull-request-count`, `closed-pull-request-count`, `open-pull-request-count`, `open-issue-count`, `closed-issue-count`, `repository-count`, `star-count`.

### Read-Only

- `cid` (String) CID of the current version of the record.
- `id` (String) AT URI of the record.
- `rkey` (String) Record key.
- `uri` (String) AT URI of the record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import atproto_tangled_profile.me self
```
